key_insight: Turbulence must be assessed in both space and time, because spatial and temporal evaluations can disagree for numerical records and neural representations.
engineering_relevance: Reliable turbulence modeling requires resolving fine spatial structures and continuous temporal evolution, rather than relying on spatial fidelity alone.
method: Analyze time-resolved direct numerical simulations of three-dimensional turbulence.
Assess how numerical choices affect resolved space–time physics.
Study how neural networks represent the recorded turbulent motion.
evidence_signal: The study uses simulation runs exceeding 28 TB each and reports disagreement between spatial and temporal assessments for both numerical records and learned representations.
watch_item: The massive data volume makes storage and processing substantial implementation concerns.
paper_title: Let's Do Turbulence Right: In Space and Time!
